skills.name: context-dev
skills.description: Use Context.dev when a task needs current public-web, company-news, website, or document data. Search the live web; read, scrape, crawl, or screenshot sites; extract structured data; parse documents; retrieve brand intelligence; monitor changes; or process large batches. Trigger even when Context.dev is not named. Do not trigger when supplied content already contains the answer, the task is about private account data, or no web or file retrieval is needed.
